walkthroughs.body_html: Beethoven's Neunte Symphonie (1824) introduced choral singing into the symphony, setting Schiller's Ode an die Freude. It was adopted as the European anthem in 1985.
Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen consists of four operas (Das Rheingold, Die Walkure, Siegfried, Gotterdammerung). Premiered at Bayreuth 1876, founding modern music drama.
Kant's moral law: act only according to a maxim you could will to be a universal law. The kategorischer Imperativ grounds ethics in reason rather than consequence.
